₿ Has Bitcoin hit bottom?

Honest answer: nobody knows until after. But analysts watch the same signals, and often read them two different ways.

This week Bitcoin fell below its 30 June close and hit a new low for 2026. So we looked at the 10 signals analysts watch to judge whether a bottom is in, from market fear to miners and long-term holders.

No predictions. Just the evidence.

▶️ Watch all 10 signals in the full video on our YouTube channel (link in bio): https://youtu.be/VHEALYRKMx0

Crypto prices can swing sharply both ways. Education, not financial advice.

Which signal do you watch? 👇
